data.message: "Upgradeable Player Stats" keeps crashing in the cave where you can get the blueprint for the spotlight; the coordinates (https//sotf.th.gl) are VI. It is the only cave where this happens; there were no issues entering any of the others.

Version 1.1.2 ,which is supposed not to change Arrow Capacity if other mod does that, still changes Arrow Capacity when you upgrade any other skill. It requires to save and restart the game after upgrade. And even after that, the capacity will be overwritten at some point.
Please make an option without Arrow Capacity at all.
Is there a way to reset the stats?
Also can I change the values? 20% increases is to OP in my opinion.
Now It is saved. Could Axel's Mod Menu be the Reason?
This resets everytime I load my save.

This works perfectly now, thank you so much! Apologies for the annoying group of comments I left, just had 'another thought' then 'another thought', lol.

Really, really appreciate this update. <3

Okay, can try to fix it later today, problem is that other mods set the capacity before you are in a world (loaded in main menu), and that wont work in this case since stats are saved on each world (loaded on game join)
at the very least, if users don't put any a point in it, make it so it does not touch arrow capacity at all. Even without the point put in arrow capacity, it still forces the max to 20

Seriously. I love this mod and the increase to my movement speed, jump height an dall that, but the moment you added the arrow capacity increase, I'm heavily debating removing it as much as I don't want to. You added an issue to this that did not need to be there at all. Please remove arrow capacity.

No, remove the arrow bit, or fix it, or something. Anyone who uses any kind of mod adjusting stack sizes, this messes with it and forces the max capacity to the much smaller 20/40 value instead of what value I set. Great idea, but if people want to increase their capacity, do it through the mod MADE for that...don't increase arrow capcity through this. It messes up too much other stuff
